title: Answer: replication, and copies prepared at the logical level

statements.text: A consciousness difference must show up as a difference in a system's future state under the same inputs, the same standard that makes experiments replicable. For computational theories the test pair can be prepared, since a computer can be set into another's logical state without running its history.

sources.quote: Including the stochastic (§4.10) and realizability extensions (§4.11), this approximates the principle of experimental replicability.
The β of §3 is therefore preparable: it requires setting logical states, not atoms.
